questions.prompt: If we ______ more people, we will get a better answer.
questions.explanation: 条件句：If 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。所以填 ask。
questions.evidence: If we use only the first survey, we will make a mistake.

questions.prompt: If the group is small, the result ______ not be true for everyone.
questions.explanation: 条件句主句可以用 may + 动词原形，表示“可能”。这里用 may 最合适。
questions.evidence: If the group is small or special, the result may not be true for everyone.

questions.prompt: There are only ______ people in the park today.
questions.explanation: people 是可数名词复数，用 a few 表示“几个”。much 和 a little 修饰不可数名词。
questions.evidence: If only a few people pass by, even coffee drinkers will not stop.

questions.prompt: We do not have ______ information about the shopping center.
questions.explanation: information 是不可数名词，用 much 表示“许多”。many 和 a few 修饰可数名词。
questions.evidence: Instead, they waited and collected more information.

questions.prompt: Only 20 ______ of the people said yes.
questions.explanation: percent 表示百分比，通常不加 s。这里说“20 percent of the people”。
questions.evidence: That was just 20 percent of the whole group.

questions.prompt: The first survey was small. ______, the team decided to ask more people.
questions.explanation: 前句是原因，后句是结果，用 Therefore（因此）连接。
questions.evidence: The team decided to check their conclusion.

questions.prompt: Leo looked at the survey again. ______ he found a problem.
questions.explanation: 表示时间顺序“然后”，用 Then。Because 和 If 不表示顺序。
questions.evidence: He looked at the survey again.

questions.prompt: If we ______ only the first survey, we will make a mistake.
questions.explanation: 条件句 If 从句用一般现在时，所以用 use。
questions.evidence: If we use only the first survey, we will make a mistake.

title: The Missing Survey: A Team Learns to Check Its Data · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
本课重点：1) 条件句：If + 一般现在时，主句用 will/can/may + 动词原形，表示“如果……就……”。例如：If we ask more people, we will get a better answer. 2) 数量词：a few（几个，少量），many（许多，可数），much（许多，不可数），a small number of（少量的），percent（百分比）。3) 段落间的指代与衔接：用 this/these/that/those 指代前文内容，用 however/therefore/instead 等连接词使段落连贯。注意：条件句主句不能用 will 再加动词原形以外的形式；数量词要与名词可数性搭配。

If we use only the first survey, we will make a mistake.
